definitions.full: H93. egoz אֱגוֺז noun [masculine] nuts (collective) (Late Hebrew id. , אַמְגּוֺזָא , Arabic , Ethiopic Aramaic , אֱגוּזָא ; compare Persian , whence probably אֱגוֺז as loan-word) Song 6:11 . אגל (Hoffm Hiob. 86 compare Arabic restrict , Ethiopic a certain one (name withheld ), etc.)
